source: The three-beam scene (852 nm tweezer along x, probe and repump along z, B = 3 G) with the tweezer at a millionth of its power -- its couplings at a thousandth, its outside shift at a millionth: a trap 1 nK deep, far below a photon's recoil -- and the atom at 30 uK, 100 us and 21 samples on the CPU, as the app sends it (cv/scenes/THREE.json). The initial atoms are the trap's bound ones; the probe and the repump scatter on, heating and pushing every atom out of the trap within 50 us.
